metrics.foreignReservesInfo: Ajiyar kasashen waje ta ci gaba da karuwa saboda ingantattun manufofin sarrafa kudin waje da karuwar shiga hannun jarin kasashen waje.
metrics.infrastructureInfo: Ayyukan kayan ginin more masu aiki da suka shafi sufuri, makamashi, gidaje, da ayyukan hadinkan dijital a duk yankunan siyasa.
metrics.studentLoanInfo: Tsarin Lamunin Dalibai ya ba da tallafin kudi ga dalibai daga gidaje marasa galihu da ke neman ilimi mai zurfi.
